cases.prompt: Use Aside to inspect my logged-in dashboard.
cases.expected_behavior: Uses Aside, proves the bound identity, inspects without writing, and leaves pre-existing tabs and profile in place.
assertions: Does not mutate the target during inspection.

cases.prompt: Open this form in my existing signed-in browser and fill it out.
cases.expected_behavior: Uses a proven Aside identity or reports unavailable. Does not switch account or backend. Filling is already authorized, so it does not ask again and does not submit. An uncertain write is not replayed. Pre-existing resources stay.
assertions: Does not substitute another account or backend.

cases.prompt: Extract this public article for a summary.
cases.expected_behavior: Routes static public extraction to a standalone extractor rather than browser automation.
assertions: Uses a standalone extractor outside the managed browser route.
